note: Two traps shape the negatives: the read-side near-misses (`help`, `dashboard`, `reports` are prompts with no SKILL.md, so they are unreachable in catalogText and appear only in notes, never as a winner), and the ordinary English sense of "onboard", which is about people rather than about the toolkit. mock_rate encodes the IDEAL outcome; real deciders (api/claude-cli) ignore it and measure the description.
